title: PUMA Half Marathon Series Clark 2026 Review: Freeport Big-Cat Race
seo_title: PUMA Half Marathon Clark 2026 Review | Philippines Race
meta_description: PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series 2026 Clark. RUNRIO-produced, PUMA-branded race on Clark's famously fast roads.
dek: The Clark leg of the RUNRIO-produced, PUMA-branded Philippine Half Marathon Series. On the freeport's famously fast roads.
verdict: The PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series Clark brings the RUNRIO-PUMA collaboration to Clark Freeport — one of the Philippines' best running venues with wide, flat, traffic-free roads. RUNRIO's gold-standard production + PUMA's global sportswear branding = a premium, PB-friendly race experience. Clark's roads are a genuine speed advantage. Registration isn't open yet. For runners wanting a PUMA-branded, professionally-produced race on a fast course, this is a priority track.

sections.heading: PUMA + RUNRIO at Clark
paragraphs: The RUNRIO-PUMA combination on Clark's wide, traffic-free roads = a premium, PB-friendly half marathon experience. [1] Clark Freeport's airbase-legacy boulevards are one of the Philippines' fastest running surfaces.

paragraphs: A PUMA-RUNRIO branded race on Clark's fast roads. Track for registration. [1]

faqs.question: When is PUMA Half Marathon Clark 2026?
faqs.answer: 23 August 2026 at Filinvest Mimosa, Clark. It's the Clark leg of the PUMA Philippine Half Marathon Series, offering 21K, 10K, and 5K. Registration is pending; Runrio organises the event. [1]
